results.title: Digital transformation in business and management research
results.content: ## International Journal of Information Management. # Digital transformation in business and management research: An overview of the current status quo. This article maps the thematic evolution of current research on digital transformation in business and management. 217 articles from leading business and management journals are analyzed using diverse methodological procedures. A synergistic framework linking current research on digital transformation with business and management is proposed. It is no surprise that research on digital transformation (DT) has raised vast interest among academics in recent decades. First, map the thematic evolution of the DT research in the areas of business and management, because existing research in these areas to date has been limited to certain domains. Based on these findings, the second objective of this paper will be to propose a synergistic framework that relates existing research on DT to the areas of business and management, which will help form the evolutionary perspective taken in this paper.

results.title: A systematic literature review of digital startup business ...
results.content: Therefore, this study attempts to fill this gap by conducting a structured literature review on digital startup dynamics and their policy interventions, emphasizing the contribution of digital startups to technological innovation, job creation, and economic growth. Additionally, the integration of digital solutions in sectors such as agriculture, sustainable energy, and environmental policies highlights the significance of supporting startups that innovate towards sustainability and environmental stewardship, as evidenced by studies like Goswami et al. Governmental roles extend into fostering innovation through local and digital transformation policies, highlighting the critical nature of a supportive regulatory framework for startup innovation, which can be both enabled and constrained by regulation (Cozzolino & Geiger, Citation2024). This comprehensive approach, integrating insights from various stages of development, is crucial for crafting policies that foster a supportive environment for startups, enabling them to thrive, innovate, and contribute to economic and social progress in an increasingly digital global economy.
